task_catalog.title: Alliance Red Packets & Tasks
task_catalog.desc: Grabs alliance red packets and collects finished alliance task & exploit milestone boxes. (Alliance Tech Auto-Donate & Both Gift Tabs run in the Always-On Automation panel.)

task_catalog.title: Radar Events (Scan + All Types)
task_catalog.desc: Triggers the top-left radar scan button first, claims finished rewards, and handles ALL radar task types: Ally Help, Gather/Dig, NPC HQ/Skull Attack, and Radar Exploration (Auto-Skip).

task_catalog.title: Daily Tasks (Complete All)
task_catalog.desc: Scans your live Daily Tasks popup and completes ALL actionable tasks in one go (Post Likes, Hero EXP, Recruitment Ticket, Building Upgrade, Tech Research, Troop Training, Speedup, Alliance Help/Donate, Radar, Bounties, Trucks, Arena, Boss Rallies, Gathering), then claims every task & milestone chest (30-150). Safely skips real-money IAP & PvP HQ attacks.

task_catalog.title: Daily Tasks & Passes
task_catalog.desc: Claims all completed Daily Tasks, Daily Activity Milestone Chests (1-6), achievements, chapter tasks, and ALL active Battle Passes & Event Passes.

task_catalog.title: VIP & Store Freebies
task_catalog.desc: Collects your daily VIP login points, VIP freebies chest, and the free reward in the 2nd tab of the Store.

task_catalog.title: War Safety Guard
task_catalog.desc: Watches for incoming enemy marches on your base or resource tiles, pulls exposed gathering squads home, and shields when safe from War Fever.

task_catalog.title: Reinforce Attacked Allies
task_catalog.desc: Sends reinforcement troops to alliance members or protected accounts when their base comes under attack.

task_catalog.title: Arena Battles (x5)
task_catalog.desc: Builds 1v1 or 3v3 pure-faction top-5 hero lineups, skips tough fights, and only challenges opponents when win odds exceed 70%.

task_catalog.title: Hero Battlefield (Quick Deploy + Auto-Skip)
task_catalog.desc: Uses Quick Deploy / Sweep where unlocked, auto-fills strongest faction heroes, and immediately triggers in-battle Skip on every stage fight.

task_catalog.title: Area Exploration (Auto-Skip)
task_catalog.desc: Collects idle stage chest rewards, executes batch jumps, and runs solo HQ Explore battles with automatic in-battle Skip enabled.

task_catalog.title: Furylord Boss (03:00)
task_catalog.desc: Targets the scheduled 03:00 Furylord window using Squad 1 so all daily boss damage rewards are secured automatically.

task_catalog.title: Tyrant Rally
task_catalog.desc: Claims free Tyrant rewards, hosts a Squad 1 rally, joins open alliance Tyrant rallies with extra squads, and repeats smoothly.

task_catalog.title: Boomer Rallies
task_catalog.desc: Joins open alliance Boomer rallies or starts new ones within your stamina reserve for hero EXP and rally rewards.

task_catalog.title: Mining Event (Mon / Tue)
task_catalog.desc: Looks for unoccupied XP or Gold event mines on Mondays and Tuesdays so farms gather event rewards safely without hitting players.

task_catalog.title: Bear Trap & Alliance Mine
task_catalog.desc: Claims Bear Trap rewards when available, joins active Bear battles, and keeps an idle squad gathering at the Alliance Mine.

task_catalog.title: Treasure Helicopter
task_catalog.desc: Claims helicopter supply drops and marches squads to active treasure digs nearby.

task_catalog.title: Research Queue
task_catalog.desc: Collects completed technologies, starts recommended or priority research automatically, applies free speedups, and asks for Alliance Help.

task_catalog.title: Free Recruits & Safe Chests
task_catalog.desc: Uses strictly free timer hero recruits and opens safe non-choice drop chests in your bag without touching choice boxes, speedups, or shields.

task_catalog.title: Garage Upgrades (Monday)
task_catalog.desc: Every Monday, equips stronger APC vehicle parts, merges matching parts, and performs free refits for event points.

task_catalog.title: Full Preparedness
task_catalog.desc: Collects Full Preparedness point chests and aligns timed progression actions with active daily event windows.

task_catalog.title: Smart Speedups
task_catalog.desc: Hits free speedup buttons as soon as timers drop into the free window; on farms, optionally spends small speedups during Preparedness.

task_catalog.title: Train Troops (Event Speed-Zoom)
task_catalog.desc: Collects finished soldiers, trains your highest unlocked tier across all barracks, and automatically speed-zooms with Training Speedups when Full Preparedness or Alliance Duel scores troop training.

task_catalog.title: Upgrade HQ & Buildings
task_catalog.desc: Harvests city resources, starts HQ or required prerequisite buildings when builders are free, and requests Alliance Help.

task_catalog.title: Gold Bounties (Lock Orange + Ally Help + Plunder)
task_catalog.desc: Unified 3-in-1 bounty engine: locks Orange/Gold missions before rolling, dispatches all golden bounties, helps alliance members' golden tasks, and plunders cross-state Lv5+ golden bounties.

task_catalog.title: Trade Trucks (Claim + Send Gold)
task_catalog.desc: Claims completed golden/old trade trucks first, waits for server sync, rolls for golden trucks, dispatches new trucks across open slots, and raids weaker cross-state trucks.
